name: Russian speech — Piper
description: Writes Russian speech to a WAV file entirely on the CPU: Piper is a small neural TTS that runs 20x faster than realtime here. Nothing leaves the machine and no GPU memory is used.
notes: Measured on this machine: 4.29 s of 22.05 kHz mono WAV in 0.18 s of inference (RTF 0.045), peak -0.0 dBFS, no GPU. Voice model: rhasspy/piper-voices ru_RU-irina-medium, MIT. Piper mispronounces mixed Latin/Cyrillic strings, so keep numbers and abbreviations in words.

parameters.label: Text to speak
parameters.default: Привет! Это локальный синтез речи. Всё считается на твоём ноутбуке, без интернета.
